questions.question: Some persons P, Q, R, S, T, U are sitting beside a round table facing the centre. S is sitting just opposite of R, who is immediate left of Q. T is sitting immediate right of Q. If U is exactly in opposite of Q, then what is the sitting location of P?
questions.solution:
Total person:- P, Q, R, S, T and U

1) S is sitting just opposite of **R, who** is immediate left of Q.

Here R is immediate left of Q. Since, use of **"Who" for 2nd person.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/cb7db9b58d92d6b55b5d0f1a8429a83ddcf09ca1e7b3b2a43e583b41a288ffd4.png] 

2) T is sitting immediate right of Q.

3) U is exactly in opposite of Q.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5542893ef867093afdbd9a26b8b76d71a9ed9e16c1be2c011271d59281a8ca18.png] 

 

Final sitting arrangments is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/81464b1f984298d5b1bef238c65309fcce6fec54594821056546af96cad85399.png] 

option (1): Left of U → False, because S is sitting to the left of U.

option (2): Between S and T → False, because nobody sits between S and T.

option (3): Right of R → False, because Q is sitting to the right of R.

option (4): Between U and R →True, because P is sitting between U and R.

Hence, ‘P' sitting between U and R.

questions.question:
Select the option in which the number-pair shares the same relationship as that shared by the following number-pair.

84 : 96
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is:

**1st Number : 2ⁿd number**

**=> 1st Number + digit sum of 1st number = 2ⁿd number**

**In **84 : 96

**1st Number + digit sum of 1st number**

= 84 + (8 + 4)

= 84 + 12

= 96 **= 2ⁿd number**

Now check the all options,

**Option (1) **46 : 60

= 46 + (4 + 6)

= 46 + 10

= 56 ≠** 2ⁿd Number**

**Option (2) **64 : 82

= 64 + (6 + 4)

= 64 + 10

= 74 ≠** 2ⁿd Number**

**Option (3) **42 : 58

= 42 + (4 + 2)

= 42 + 6

= 48 ≠ **2ⁿd Number**

**Option (4) 68 : 82**

**1st Number + digit sum of 1st number**

**= 68 + (6 + 8)**

**= 68 + 14**

**= 82** **= 2ⁿd Number**

Hence, the correct answer is **"****68 : 82****".**

questions.question: The way 'Dog' is related to 'Puppy', in the same way 'Sheep' is related to '______'.
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is:

'Dog' is related to 'Puppy' → Baby 'Dog' is** **called** 'Puppy'.**

Similarly,

**'Sheep' is related to** ‘Lamb’ → Baby **'Sheep' is** called 'Lamb'.

Hence, ‘Lamb’ is the correct answer.

questions.question:
Select the option in which the numbers are related in the same way, as the numbers of the following set.

98 : 81 : 72
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is:

**Step → 1st number**

**Step → 2ⁿd number = 1st number 1st digit × 9**

**Step → 3rd number = 1st number 2ⁿd digit × 9**

For 98 : 81 : 72

Step → 1st number = 98

Step → 2ⁿd number = 9 × 9 = 81

Step → 3rd number = 8 × 9 = 72

**Option 1 → **76 : 63 : 54

**Step → 1st number = 76**

**Step → 2ⁿd number = 7 × 9 = 63**

**Step → 3rd number = 6 × 9 = 54**

**Option 2** → 68 : 56 : 46

Step → 1st number = 68

Step → 2ⁿd number = 6 × 9 = 54 ≠ 56

Step → 3rd number = 8 × 9 = 72 ≠ 46

**Option 3 → **72 : 63 : 55

Step → 1st number = 72

Step → 2ⁿd number = 7 × 9 = 63

Step → 3rd number = 2 × 9 = 18 ≠ 55

**Option 4** → 68 : 54 : 44

Step → 1st number = 68

Step → 2ⁿd number = 6 × 9 = 54

Step → 3rd number = 8 × 9 = 72 ≠ 44

Hence, the correct answer is **"76 : 63 : 54".**

questions.question: If in a coding system, MUSICAL is coded as 109 and RAISING is coded as 110, then how will FOURTH be coded in the same coding system?
questions.solution:
The table is alphabets place value:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/259d8630a9ac11653540776fb8c878efe7c7e39d2fafd27847036c083bb6c14d.png] 

The pattern followed here is:

Sum of the opposite alphabets places value - 2 = number.

MUSICAL is coded as 109

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/fee7c1a327325cf954c1c45a3e08f8dd4290b3e80aa3fd4719a5a3617b8873e0.png] 

Sum of the opposite alphabets places value - 2 = number

=> (14 + 6 + 8 + 18 + 24 + 26 + 15) - 2 = 111 - 2 = 109

And,

RAISING is coded as 110

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2cd9d5fe5cb48efa4d460dcbad82427509b0c110c12516f44bd89469f2e84d2b.png] 

Sum of the opposite alphabets places value - 2 = number

=> (9 + 26 + 18 + 8 + 18 + 13 + 20) - 2 = 112 - 2 = 110

Similarly,

**FOURTH** = ?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5eeb44f147329938d25b6310f4a973c3766cee0ef97f82510512c52c8cfa7a5b.png] 

**Sum of the opposite alphabets places value - 2 = number**

**=> (21 + 12 + 6 + 9 + 7 + 19) - 2 = 74 - 2 = 72**

Hence, the correct answer is "72".

questions.question:
Two statements are given, followed by two conclusions numbered I and II. Assuming the statements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements. 

**Statements:**

All heads are tails.

All tails are bones. 

**Conclusions:**

I. All bones are heads.

II. All heads are bones.

options.text: Both conclusions I and II follow.
Neither conclusion I nor II follows.

questions.solution:
Statements:

All heads are tails.

All tails are bones. 

The least possible diagram for the given statements is as follows

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9c800f43cd23d87efbb2173f27d163940d90b83c00b1dcd00464823187248fa3.png] 

Conclusions:

I. All bones are heads → False (It is possible but not definite)

II. All heads are bones → True (Because all heads are tails and all tails are bones so all heads are definitely bones)

Hence, “**Only conclusion II follows**” is the correct answer.
